payload.prompt: Crie o projeto "Análise Rio" vinculado ao cliente Rio Azul Lda (org. nº 912018431). O gerente de projeto é Inês Rodrigues (ines.rodrigues@example.org).

payload.goal: Create project "Análise Rio" linked to customer Rio Azul Lda (org. no. 912018431) with project manager Inês Rodrigues (ines.rodrigues@example.org).
success_checks: Customer Rio Azul Lda with organization number 912018431 exists
Employee Inês Rodrigues with email ines.rodrigues@example.org exists
Project "Análise Rio" is linked to customer Rio Azul Lda
Project manager on the project is set to Inês Rodrigues
risk_notes: Sandbox is empty; customer must be created before project can be linked
Project manager may need to exist as an employee before assignment
No project start date, code, or department provided; defaults may be required
Email alone may not uniquely identify an employee if duplicates exist
ordered_steps: Create customer Rio Azul Lda via customer endpoint using organization number 912018431
Create employee Inês Rodrigues via employee endpoint using email ines.rodrigues@example.org if no matching employee exists
Create project "Análise Rio" via project endpoint
Update or create project relations to link the project to customer Rio Azul Lda
Assign Inês Rodrigues as project manager on the project via project update endpoint
Verify project, customer link, and manager assignment

planned_endpoints.summary: Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'STANDARD' unless admin is explicitly requested.
Requires customer={"id": customer_id} and projectManager={"id": employee_id}.
startDate is REQUIRED — use today_iso from execution_brief if prompt doesn't specify a date.
If a default hourly rate already exists (409 Duplicate entry), GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=... then PUT to update it.
